name: CRM_UPDATE_COMPETITIVE_CONFIG
purpose: Guarda la config per-cliente del competitive analysis (competitive_enabled, competitive_frequency_days, competitive_recipients). Usado por el frontend TabGbp.

parameters.query: UPDATE clientes.clientes SET competitive_enabled = {{ $json.body.competitive_enabled }}, competitive_frequency_days = {{ $json.body.competitive_frequency_days }}, competitive_recipients = '{{ JSON.stringify($json.body.competitive_recipients) }}'::jsonb WHERE id = {{ $json.body.cliente_id }} RETURNING id, competitive_enabled, competitive_frequency_days, competitive_recipients
